verdict.rationale: GitHub Actions is referenced via marketing copy ('Ship faster with secure, reliable CI/CD') but the evidence pack lacks any detailed documentation of GitHub-hosted runners, their images, or setup, and community input focuses only on Actions outage complaints rather than confirming the hosted-runner experience. Missing for 10: hosted-runner spec docs (OS images, concurrency, autoscaling), first-party CI/CD pipeline walkthrough, and independent corroboration that jobs run without any user-side infrastructure setup.
